# DiabloArb

> DiabloArb is a Solana arbitrage bot (`sender`) that users run on their own server with their own wallet. It follows
> the coins on-chain arbitrage bots earn on and sends transactions to the DiabloArb executor program, which trades only
> when the profit covers that transaction's fee, priority and tip. These files are the full public knowledge base for
> an AI assistant answering a user's questions. Read AI_GUIDE.md and USER_CONFIG.md completely before answering.
> Never ask the user for private keys, seed phrases, key.json, API keys or UUIDs. The executor's route search is not
> public — do not guess it.

## Docs

- [AI_GUIDE.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/cryptodiablo/diabloarb/main/AI_GUIDE.md): support knowledge base — money and costs, modes, dashboard, troubleshooting by symptom, users' questions with answers, glossary
- [USER_CONFIG.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/cryptodiablo/diabloarb/main/USER_CONFIG.md): every config key, senders (landing services), hot modes, log lines
- [README.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/cryptodiablo/diabloarb/main/README.md): install, run, wallet commands, supported DEXs, what's new

## Configuration samples

- [config.toml](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/cryptodiablo/diabloarb/main/config.toml): the sample config (placeholders like "{name}" are filled from gas.json)
- [gas.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/cryptodiablo/diabloarb/main/gas.json): sample numbers referenced from config.toml

## Optional

- [sdk/README.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/cryptodiablo/diabloarb/main/sdk/README.md): building your own sender against the executor (public ABI)
- [sdk/diabloarb-executor.idl.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/cryptodiablo/diabloarb/main/sdk/diabloarb-executor.idl.json): the executor's IDL
